elaine: quick handoff - initial bringup of nova-70b q5_0 with speculative decode. saw some promising throughput but a few consistency regressions. dumping notes.
mya: short summary numbers?
elaine: running single-token latency (batch=1) microbench vs baseline (no-spec): p50 -10ms, p95 -40ms, p99 -90ms on steady load. on bursty mixes p99 sometimes +220ms. throughput improved ~1.25x under medium concurrency.
sophie: interesting. where do the regressions show up?
elaine: two patterns: 1) mis-speculation cascades mid-long context (>512) causing token divergence and higher perplexity on some QA prompts; 2) kernel fallback when quant merge hits non-aligned tensors under certain seq-lens -> big memcpy stalls. pasted small trace below.
```
[TRACE] id=6178889999 start speculative=window=4
step=kv_merge duration_ms=3.7 -> 14.2 fallback=true memcpy_ms=78
cpu: user=82% steal=12% ctxsw=high
note: kernel=quant_merge_v2 -> scalar_merge_path
```
arjun: can we reproduce deterministically with controlled load? bench-bot, queue a 10k prompt replay with seq_len_dist pinned and --affinity=node-local --dump-kernel-stats.
bench-bot: queued job id rb-6178890001. will run on pool-gpu-dedicated (3 nodes). estimated finish 2h.
mya: for the quality regressions, what's our eval plan? small 2k QA + 1k open-ended summarization + hallucination probes? also measure top1 token match and edit distance on generated continuations.
sophie: yes. I'll run the 4x config grid: spec_window=[1,2,4,8], backstop=false/true. Quant profiles q5_0 and q4_1. total 16 runs, 2 seeds each. will collect diffs and store outputs in s3://rnw-spec/nova70b/grid/6178889999/.
elaine: preliminary toy-run: window=8, backstop=false, q5_0 -> EM on tight-QA dropped 0.8 pts vs baseline, F1 stable. hallucination-rate +3% on our news-sources set. examples attached below (trimmed):
"Prompt: Who is the current CEO of Acme Corp?"
baseline: "Jordan Reeves."
spec-win8: "Jordan Reeves (CEO since 2022)."
spec-win8-fail: "I believe it might be Jordan, or possibly someone else"
(more failures are paraphrase/incomplete answers, not hallucinated facts)
arjun: that pattern suggests early local mistakes that don't catastrophically invent facts but reduce confidence/clarity. might be tolerable depending on SLAs. we should also run long-tail stability: 24h run with mixed traffic to see drift.
mya: also add check: seed vs non-deterministic kernel paths. run with --deterministic-kernel on and off to see variance.
sophie: noted. I'll add kernel flag matrix: --deterministic-kernel=[true,false] and --no-prefetch toggle. that'll make the grid 64 jobs. will prioritize smaller sample eval first.
bench-bot: placing high-priority jobs first. job ids: rb-6178890102..rb-6178890165.
elaine: next steps: 1) Sophie runs grid + small eval (today). 2) Arjun/infra to enable kernel debug on one node and collect perf counters during high tail events. 3) Mya organizes diff bundle for failed QA examples and KV timeline traces. 4) decision checkpoint after grid: if EM drop <0.5 and p99 latency <+100ms favoring spec, consider canary.
arjun: also add metric: token-level agreement rate and downstream BLEU/ROUGE on summarization set.
mya: ok will script token-agreement extractor. also adding a small human review queue for borderline failures.
sophie: kicking off now, will post summaries + s3 links when ready. :thumbsup:
elaine: thanks team. leaving logs in /perf/nova70b/bringup/6178889999/ and will update thread when results land.
